outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart (cell death %) reporting mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars representing averaged data, but no individual data points are shown on top of the bars.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three experiments at multiple time points, but the underlying individual data points are not displayed.
Panel D shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars, but the individual data points behind the averages are not plotted.
